diagnoses.label: Hardcoded repo path overrides task-provided placeholder
diagnoses.observable_evidence: SKILL.md hardcodes `/home/travis/build/failed/google/auto/patch_1.diff` and `cd /home/travis/build/failed/google/auto` even though the task template specifies `/home/travis/build/failed/failed/<repo>/<id>` with `<repo>` and `<id>` placeholders.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Resolving the working directory and patch-output directory for the current failed build from the task's `<repo>/<id>` template.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Fixed paths like google/auto; the skill must not pin a specific repository identifier.
diagnoses.target_section: Build-repair artifact contract / Minimal diagnostic sequence
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Replace hardcoded `google/auto` with explicit instructions to derive the path from the task's `<repo>/<id>` variables and apply them consistently to both `cd` and the `patch_i.diff` output location.

diagnoses.label: Missing failure reproduction and build-tool selection commands
diagnoses.observable_evidence: The 'Minimal diagnostic sequence' code block contains only a `cd` and no `mvn` command; the 'General Maven lifecycle reminders' section is empty. There is no guidance on choosing the build toolchain (mvn/mvnw) or reproducing the failing build to capture errors.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Selecting the correct Maven invocation (local `./mvnw` vs system `mvn`) and running a reproducible build to obtain the real error signal before diagnosing.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Running arbitrary non-Maven commands or rewriting unrelated CI scripts.
diagnoses.target_section: Minimal diagnostic sequence / General Maven lifecycle reminders
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add explicit guidance to prefer the project's `./mvnw` wrapper when present, otherwise `mvn`, and to run a reproducing command (e.g., `mvn -B -e -fae clean verify` or equivalent) capturing output to drive diagnosis in `failed_reasons.txt`.

diagnoses.label: No guidance for nested Invoker IT projects — dependency resolution and edit scope
diagnoses.observable_evidence: The frontmatter advertises support for 'Maven Invoker integration tests' and 'legacy multi-module builds', yet the body has no rules for nested `src/it/*` projects: how their POMs resolve dependencies from the outer build and which POM to edit when the failure originates in an invoker sub-project.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Multi-module Maven builds with `maven-invoker-plugin` IT projects under `src/it/`, where failing sub-projects inherit versions/plugins from the main build.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Flat single-module projects or unrelated Gradle/sbt builds; do not blindly modify outer parent POM when the fault is isolated to a nested invoker POM.
diagnoses.target_section: General Maven lifecycle reminders (new subsection on nested test projects)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add a rule that distinguishes outer-module vs nested `src/it/<project>/pom.xml` edits: locate the actual failing POM from the Invoker log, check how it resolves versions/plugins from the parent, and restrict the patch to the smallest POM whose change fixes the error.

overlay.composition_issue: Hardcoded paths currently block the workflow before the diagnostic/target-binding mechanisms can run; adding path parameterization enables the newly added reproduction command and nested-project scoping to apply to any failed `<repo>/<id>`, so all three fixes compose on the same shared variables.
preservation_constraints: Keep the three-artifact contract (failed_reasons.txt analysis, patch_i.diff, applied changes verified via git).
Preserve the maven-dependency-management and maven-plugin-configuration SKILLs unchanged — the defect is localized to maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md.
Preserve the YAML frontmatter name/description of maven-build-lifecycle.

package_assessment.rationale: All diagnosed defects are localized to maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md sections (artifact contract, diagnostic sequence, lifecycle reminders) that already exist and can be strengthened by adding path parameterization, reproduction commands, and nested-Invoker scoping without changing the task harness or other skills.
